The '''Shuxl system''' was a part of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] and featured rings of powder&mdash;as opposed to [[Planet/Legends|planets]]&mdash;as well as a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|hyperspace nav buoy]]. Like the rest of the Yarith [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was originally part of the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] and the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] both passed through the Shuxl system on separate occasions.

==Description==
The Shuxl system was located in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], a part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Anantapar system/Legends|Anantapar system]] and the neighboring [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector's]] [[Ertegas system/Legends|Ertegas system]]. The Shuxl [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated within the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]],<ref name="TEA" /> and it contained rings of powder<ref name="GG" /> but no [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:AnoatSectorMap.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Shuxl system was situated within the Ivax Nebula and was successively a part of the Javin, Anoat, and Yarith sectors.]]
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing the Shuxl system was re-designated as the new Anoat sector, and generations after that, the Anoat itself was further split into two parts, with Shuxl becoming a part of the Yarith sector.<ref name="GG" /> The Shuxl system was notable only for a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|hyperspace nav buoy]] that helped re-orient [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the Corellian Trade Spine.<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled from the Anoat sector's [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] to the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]] of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in order to undergo further [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] his [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Skywalker transited the Shuxl system on the way to the Dagobah system. Later, the Jedi passed through the same system on a return journey to the Anoat sector that he undertook in order to rescue his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&ndash;aligned friends after witnessing them being in danger via a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] subsequently likewise traveled through the Shuxl system while journeying to a [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous]] with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shuxl system was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
